patch: Frozen working changes limited to sdd_history.py, sdd_check.py and test_history_file_cache.py; design report separately untracked. Read-only Git inspection; no repository Git mutation.
requested_profile: gpt-6.1-sol/high inherited; effective host model/effort not independently verified

source_review.result: Private checker scope wraps snapshot_hash_scope(audit=True). Lease binds checker identity and actual owner, is context-local, invalidates shared active flag before scope exit/audit, and restores parent context in finally. Copied expired contexts cannot revive the lease. Outer depth exit clears memo and other owner state even on audit error.

Memo only applies under exact active checker/owner with positive owner depth and invocation_active. Namespace includes canonical project plus exact legacy reference path/hash; full record semantic digest and complete saved registration tuple must match. First validation is unchanged validate_files, registers every frozen file before memo population. Missing or changed registrations require full validation. Every reuse checks all current logical paths via physical.

Each resolve freshly reads/hashes exact legacy reference and original manifest reference, checks event/version/unverified_not_reusable acceptance and supported original legacy format. Only frozen-file validation is memoized; invalid manifests/refs still deny before any reuse.

Hash owner adds invocation-local legacy_files only; stable hash/signature guards and audit are unchanged. Final audit inspects full frozen union, including files unused by current projected acceptance, with existing parent/link/regular-file and Windows descriptor checks.

Checker.run now owns private lease and audited scope. Any final audit failure cannot return a passed result: a completed report is changed to blocked; before report completion the error propagates. _run_invocation still resets active flag in finally. No writer or generic helper receives a lease merely by opening an arbitrary snapshot scope.

counterexamples_examined: Frozen equal-size mutation during a memo hit is caught at mandatory checker return audit.
Mutation to unused snapshot is caught before nested child returns and again at root scope.
Expired copied lease plus stale caller flag cannot reuse.
Semantic record/reference/original-manifest hash changes cannot reuse old semantic validation.
Current logical symlink and cross-project namespace cannot borrow frozen snapshot trust.
Missing registration triggers full validation and rejects changed bytes.
Checker semantic failure still audits full union and preserves original exception as context.
Nested outer-scope stage/activation retain direct generic snapshot errors before write_new/store_record/os.replace; manifest hash unchanged and no activation lock left.
